Metallurgical Certification

Safety Is Not A Marketing Slogan

Every InvisProtect installation is backed by physical laboratory metallurgical certification, calibrated mechanical tensioning, and strict work-at-height engineering standards.

SS316 MARINE ALLOY

Virgin SS316 Marine Grade

Enriched with 2.5% Molybdenum to prevent pitting corrosion. Will never rust or stain, even in coastal salt air or heavy monsoon climates.

400+ KGF TESTED

400+ kg Breaking Load

High-tensile cables withstand massive instantaneous impact. Impossible for toddlers or energetic pets to separate or force through.

IS 3521 HARNESS

Certified Technicians

Our field teams undergo rigorous work-at-height certification. Every high-rise tower installation utilizes dual-lanyard lifelines and helmet gear.

10 YEARS DIRECT

10-Year Direct Guarantee

Written guarantee certificate on cable tensile integrity and aluminium track anchoring, including complimentary re-tensioning inspection.

OFFICIAL WARRANTY POLICY

10-Year Direct Manufacturer Warranty Terms

Clear, documented, and transferable warranty protection on all SS316 marine cables and aerospace track mountings.

What Is Covered:

  • ✓ 10-Year Zero Rust Guarantee on virgin AISI 316 stainless steel wires.
  • ✓ Structural integrity of 6063-T6 aerospace extruded aluminium tracks.
  • ✓ Free mechanical re-tensioning checkup within first 12 months.
  • ✓ Complete replacement of defective mounting hardware or anchor bolts.

Claim Process & Service:

  • ✓ Direct digital warranty card provided with unique project ID upon completion.
  • ✓ 24-48 hour technician inspection response across Hyderabad, Vizag & Vijayawada.
  • ✓ Zero labor fees for verified warranty repairs or cable tension adjustments.
  • ✓ Simple photo submission via WhatsApp customer service desk.
